card.name: Words leading into surgery or bracing
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words (a, with, than, required, needs, or) right before a treatment such as surgery, brace or procedures, in orthopedic or surgical text.

modes.label: Treated with a...
modes.description: Words after 'treated' that lead into a named treatment like a brace.
modes.example: Scheuermann's disease is treated with<< a>> brace and physical therapy.

modes.label: Needs or required
modes.description: Verbs saying a patient needs or required further procedures or surgery.
modes.example: patients who experienced chondrolysis have<< required>> additional diagnostic and therapeutic procedures

modes.label: Surgery lists
modes.description: Linking words or periods in lists of surgical settings or treatment sentences.
modes.example: Prophylaxis in hip<< or>> knee replacement surgery 30 mg administered
